title: $SU(\mathcal{N})$ baryon formation in the early Universe and dark matter
summary: We study the formation of $\mathcal{N}$-quark baryons during the confinement crossover of an $SU(\mathcal{N})$ gauge theory containing quarks in the fundamental representation, with masses around or below the confinement scale. We assume stepwise baryon formation through the successive fusion of pairs of quark-clusters, with color interaction rates obeying quadratic Casimir scaling. We include the complete set of reactions between $SU(\mathcal{N})$ antisymmetric clusters dressed with their specific spin-flavor multiplicities.
